newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says it has downed an "evasive" foreign plane.
newsitem.headline: Peru says it has downed an "evasive" foreign plane.

text.p: Peru's air force said on Tuesday it had shot down an unidentified foreign plane, believed to be carrying drugs out of the country, that ignored repeated warnings after violating national air territory.

The white twin-motor plane was brought down shortly before 7 p.m. EDT (2300 GMT) on Monday over the eastern jungle region of Junin after radio and visual warnings brought "evasive manoeuvres intended to avoid capture," an air force statement said.
Air force officials would not confirm whether the plane's crew was killed or give more details about the incident.

The air force has recently stepped up efforts to patrol Peru's airspace, especially over drug-growing jungle regions where foreign and local traffickers fly out coca leaves, used in the illegal cocaine trade.
In the past Peru has shot down planes from Colombia carrying drugs.
